# qualys_was_dns_override (Resource)

A Qualys WAS DNS override record: resolves one or more hostnames to
user-defined IP addresses during crawling and scanning — for scanning
dev/UAT environments, private applications with no public DNS, or
redirecting a hostname to an alternative back-end. Reference the ID from
`qualys_was_scan_schedule`'s `dns_override_id` to use it on a schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qualys_was_dns_override" "customer_production" {
  name = "Customer Production DNS"

  mapping {
    host_name  = "portal.customer.com"
    ip_address = "10.100.5.20"
  }
  mapping {
    host_name  = "api.customer.com"
    ip_address = "10.100.5.21"
  }

  comments = ["Created automatically during customer provisioning."]
}

resource "qualys_was_scan_schedule" "storefront_weekly" {
  name       = "Storefront weekly scan"
  web_app_id = qualys_web_application.storefront.id
  type       = "VULNERABILITY"

  dns_override_id = qualys_was_dns_override.customer_production.id

  start_date      = "2026-09-01T02:00:00Z"
  time_zone_code  = "Europe/London"
  occurrence_type = "ONCE"
}
```

## Provenance

Confirmed against a user-supplied walkthrough carrying inline citations to
specific docs.qualys.com pages (count/search/get/create/update/delete for
this object) — stronger provenance than a plain transcription, though still
not a direct primary-source read. It corrected the endpoint path this
provider's discovery notes had recorded (`was/dnsoverride`, not
`was/dnsoverriderecord`).

**A genuine API quirk, internal to this resource's implementation:** update
and delete take no ID in the URL path, unlike every other WAS object this
provider models — the ID travels inside the request body for update, and as
a search filter criterion for delete. This does not change how you use the
resource in configuration.

`mapping` and `comments` are sent as a full authoritative replacement on
every apply (the "set" idiom), not an incremental add/remove — consistent
with how Terraform expresses desired state elsewhere in this provider (tags,
web application auth-record associations excepted, where an add/remove
idiom was independently confirmed).

## Schema

### Required

- **name** (String) DNS override record name.
- **mapping** (Block List, Min: 1) One hostname/IP override. Repeat for each hostname to redirect.
  - **host_name** (String) Hostname or fully qualified domain name to override.
  - **ip_address** (String) IPv4 address to resolve `host_name` to.

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **comments** (List of String) Administrative notes.
- **tag_ids** (Set of String) Asset tag IDs (see `qualys_asset_tag`) associated with this record.

### Read-Only

- **created** (String)
- **updated** (String)

## Import

```shell
terraform import qualys_was_dns_override.customer_production 57020
```
